371:t_1:172.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... My name's $$ティティ$$. What's yours?」

371:t_1:174.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$f, are you from the camp too? I've never seen you there, though...」

371:t_1:175.en:
$n
「Not exactly. I came here to volunteer.」

371:t_1:177.en:
$n
「It means working for other people with a heart for service.」

371:t_1:179.en:
$n
「...I don't know. I enjoy it, in my own way.」

371:t_1:180.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I want you to teach me too. If it's fun for you, $f.」

371:t_1:183.en:
$n
「It's not that. It just came out of nowhere, so I was a little startled.」

371:t_1:184.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Aren't surprises like that fun?」

371:t_1:185.en:
$n
「...You're cheerful. If you're in that camp, you must be in a tough situation.」

371:t_1:186.en:
$$ティティ$$
「The camp, huh... There's been a weird guy over there since about yesterday...」

371:t_1:189.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Um... isn't that the emergency alert...?」

371:t_1:190.en:
$n
「Evacuate, $$ティティ$$! This place is about to become a battlefield!」

371:t_2:3.en:
$$香月$$
「What are you saying?! The $$神ファミリー$$ are fighting for us, aren't they?!」

371:t_2:6.en:
$$香月$$
「You're the one who doesn't understand!」

371:t_2:8.en:
$$アキ$$
「I'm sorry, Auntie. I'm late getting here.」

371:t_2:9.en:
$$ミチ$$
「I heard some strange man was making a scene over there, so I came to look, and to think he's saying things like that...」

371:t_2:10.en:
$$花江$$
「$$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$... You two too...」

371:t_2:11.en:
$$香月$$
「Listen, the $$神ファミリー$$... Listen, $$勝平$$! They're risking their lives to protect us!」

371:t_2:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「To begin with, this $$ガイゾック$$ or whatever attacked because of them, the descendants of the $$ビアル星人$$.」

371:t_2:13.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'm sure it's the same with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

371:t_2:14.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Is it, though...? Then why are the $$サイデリアル$$ building those $$レイライン$$ things?」

371:t_2:16.en:
$$香月$$
「Everyone, remember! What we did to the $$神ファミリー$$!」

371:t_2:18.en:
$$香月$$
「We were just like that guy... We branded the $$神ファミリー$$ as villains on our own, and hurled abuse at them just the way he does...」

371:t_2:19.en:
$$アキ$$
「But $$勝平$$ and the others fought for us! To protect us and the Earth!」

371:t_2:20.en:
$$ミチ$$
「The people here must know! What kind of people the $$神ファミリー$$ are!」

371:t_2:21.en:
$$香月$$
「Remember! We all apologized to $$勝平$$ and the others, didn't we?! What did he and $$兵左衛門$$ say to us then?!」

371:t_2:22.en:
$$香月$$
「Anyone can make a mistake... Don't worry about what's over and done with... That's how they forgave us, didn't they?!」

371:t_2:23.en:
$$アキ$$
「And still you'd do the same thing again?! Doubting $$勝平$$ and the others?!」

371:t_2:24.en:
$$ミチ$$
「That's not okay...! It's just too sad for $$勝平$$... too sad!」

371:t_2:26.en:
$$市民$$
「I was ashamed of myself back then. Of how I shamelessly thanked the $$神ファミリー$$ after persecuting them so badly...」

371:t_2:27.en:
$$市民$$
「I was sure I'd made a vow back then... That I'd believe in them no matter what...」

371:t_2:28.en:
$$市民$$
「Hang in there, $$神ファミリー$$!」

371:t_2:31.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Shouldn't you run? You're the next one who's getting beaten to a pulp.」

371:t_3:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...Was this really okay, $$勝平$$? Didn't you want to see more of your friends, or be babied by your mom?」

371:t_3:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「As long as I know $$香月$$ and the others and Mom are doing fine, that's good enough.」

371:t_3:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Besides, once the fighting's over, we can see them again.」

371:t_3:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$葵$$, have you fallen for me?」

371:t_3:11.en:
$$葵$$
「You're five... no, ten years too early to be saying such precocious things.」

371:t_3:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch...! After all that, I'm still just a kid to you.」

371:t_3:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「Don't sulk, $$勝平$$. You'll be a grown-up before you know it.」

371:t_3:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Before I know it... when's that?」

371:t_3:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「Hmm... in about five... ten years, I'd say.」

371:t_3:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's no different from what Sis $$葵$$ said!」

371:t_3:17.en:
$$くらら$$
「Looks like that's everyone's unanimous opinion.」

371:t_3:18.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Don't worry about it, $$勝平$$. It's more comfortable being a kid, you know.」

371:t_3:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「Saying stuff like that is why you ended up homeless.」

371:t_3:20.en:
$$朔哉$$
「It's fine! I lived on the streets because I liked it!」

371:t_3:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'd hate that. A huge mansion with a pool, a cool car, lots of beauties and a butler...」

371:t_3:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「Big Bro $$万丈$$ is what I'm aiming for!」

371:t_3:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Dreaming about that kind of thing is what makes you still a child.」

371:t_3:25.en:
$$勝平$$
「So I'm still just a kid to you...!」

371:t_3:26.en:
$$葵$$
(But you're happy, $$勝平$$. You have a family, you have friends...)

371:t_3:27.en:
$$万丈$$
(And you're climbing the steps to adulthood. You're already a full-fledged warrior.)

371:t_3:28.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Well then, shall we... eat the ohagi $$勝平$$'s grandma sent along with us?」

371:t_3:30.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Don't wolf it down, $$トッポ$$. I'll make the tea now.」

371:t_3:31.en:
$$トッポ$$
「But come on, when it comes down to it, we had to leave Japan right after the volunteering was over, and we've hardly had a proper meal.」
